meta.description: KempnerForge codebase map — files, classes, functions, tests, and registry entries
meta.note: Keep in sync as phases are implemented. Latest landings: VLM (Joint-Decoder, Cross-Attention, Mixture-of-Transformers) + freeze schedule + vision encoder registry + checkpoint helpers (peek_saved_step, flush_pending_save, cross-arch freeze-meta intersection) + FSDP2 helpers (_fsdp_wrap_transformer_blocks, _apply_fsdp_vlm, _build_vlm). Also: FlexAttention packed-attention backend (model/masking.py, ModelConfig.attention_backend).

Registry.purpose: Central registry for named components (models, optimizers, schedulers, losses, vision encoders, VLM configs, modality strategies)
methods: register_adapter(name, accepts=None, output_num_tokens=None) (output_num_tokens(config, n) -> the adapter's token count, which AdapterConfig.output_num_tokens returns for the config-time sequence-length checks)

kempnerforge/config/schema.py.purpose: Backward-compatible re-exports — all config classes defined in submodules below

ModelConfig.purpose: Architecture hyperparameters (dim, layers, heads, vocab, MoE, QK-norm)

TrainConfig.purpose: Training hyperparameters (steps, batch, seq_len, precision, loss, grad accum, NaN detector action and threshold)

OptimizerConfig.purpose: Optimizer settings (name, lr, betas, weight_decay, muon params, schedule_free_warmup_steps, weight_decay_scope, lr_multipliers per vlm.module_patterns module)

SchedulerConfig.purpose: LR schedule (type, warmup, min_lr_ratio, WSD params, wsd_decay_type, rex_alpha)

DatasetSource.purpose: Single data source in a multi-dataset mixture (path or HF, weight, name)

TrainingPhase.purpose: Step-triggered phase with dataset weight overrides and LR scaling for data annealing

DataConfig.purpose: Data pipeline (dataset_path, HF dataset, tokenizer, packing, mixing, phases, annealing)

DistributedConfig.purpose: Parallelism dimensions (tp, pp, cp, ep, dp_replicate, dp_shard, fsdp)

JobConfig.purpose: Top-level config aggregating all sub-configs, cross-section validation
methods: masks_frames_in_backend_attention() (whether frame masks reach self-attention under model.sdpa_backend: the arch picks the strategy, the class the attention)
check_flash_attention_masks() (refuses sdpa_backend=flash for a training run whose batches carry a mask; the training setup calls it on CUDA)

kempnerforge/config/vlm.py.purpose: VLM (vision-language model) configuration. Discriminated union over `arch`: joint_decoder | cross_attention | mot. Each subclass registered via @registry.register_vlm_config

FreezeSpec.purpose: Single freeze directive (module alias or fnmatch pattern, frozen flag; a pattern holds a dot or one of *?[, see is_parameter_pattern, and VLMConfig refuses a bare word that is no alias). Consumed by training/freeze.py

FreezeStage.purpose: Step-boundary freeze transition (start_step + tuple of FreezeSpecs). Strictly monotonic in start_step

VLMConfig.purpose: Base VLM configuration. Subclasses register via @registry.register_vlm_config and override the `arch` field's default

JointDecoderConfig(VLMConfig).purpose: Joint-Decoder: image embeds prepended to text via prefix_embeds + output_slice. arch='joint_decoder'

CrossAttentionConfig(VLMConfig).purpose: Cross-Attention (Llama-3-V style): image K/V flows into separate CrossAttentionBlocks at a configurable cadence. arch='cross_attention'

MoTConfig(VLMConfig).purpose: Mixture-of-Transformers (Liang et al. 2024 Algorithm 1): per-modality Q/K/V/O + per-modality FFN at every layer with single global SDPA. arch='mot'

functions: _with_dotted_keys(table, keys) -> dict (a dotted override's keys set on a dict-valued field's table, the rest kept)
_dict_field_value(raw, current) -> dict (a dotted override merges into current, a literal replaces it)
_coerce_value(field_type, value) (refuses a value that cannot stand for the type; a dict's values take its value type)
_coerce_bool(value) -> bool (a bool, 0 or 1, or a true/false spelling; else ValueError)
_coerce_number(field_type, value) (an int or float from a number or numeric string; refuses bools and fractional ints)
_coerce_field(dc_type, name, hint, raw) (_coerce_value whose errors name dc_type.name)

TransformerBlock.purpose: Single pre-norm transformer block (attention + MLP with residuals). Used on text-only / Joint-Decoder / Cross-Attention paths

Transformer.purpose: Full decoder-only transformer (embed -> blocks -> norm -> head). Branches on isinstance(config.vlm, MoTConfig) to build MoTBlocks + per-modality mot_norms + per-modality forward path; on isinstance(config.vlm, CrossAttentionConfig) to interleave CrossAttentionBlocks at cadence; otherwise the JD / text-only path. Forward accepts a `modality: ModalityContext` kwarg with cross-arg invariants vs kv_caches
methods: forward(tokens, *, modality, kv_caches, doc_ids, position_ids, attention_group_ids)
init_weights_and_freqs() (ties a tied output head to the embedding again after to_empty, then initializes)
balance_routers() (one all-reduce of every sigmoid router's pending counts, then balance; every rank calls it after optimizer.step)
detach_router_losses() (detaches every router's aux_loss and z_loss once the loss holds them)

ModalityContext.purpose: Frozen dataclass bundling all modality-injection inputs flowing into Transformer.forward (inputs_embeds, prefix_embeds, output_slice, image_features, image_mask, modality_ids, key_padding_mask, position_ids, attention_group_ids, rope_cos, rope_sin, inline_embeds + inline_rows + inline_positions, output_rows + output_positions). Intra-context invariants enforced in __post_init__; cross-arg invariants vs kv_caches enforced at the top of Transformer.forward

CrossAttention.purpose: Cross-attention operator: text Q attends to image K/V. GQA + RoPE-free (image positions are not autoregressive)

CrossAttentionBlock.purpose: Pre-norm CA block: norm -> CrossAttention -> residual, norm -> MLP -> residual. Zero-init residual projections (o_proj + down_proj) so the block is identity at construction (warm-start property)

MoTAttention.purpose: Per-modality Q/K/V/O projections (nn.ModuleDict keyed by modality) with one global SDPA over the modality-concatenated sequence. Algorithm 1 of Liang et al. (2024). Per-modality QK-norm + per-modality RoPE; image-then-text concat layout matches Chameleon-style causal masking. o_proj.{m}.weight zero-init at construction.

MoTBlock.purpose: Pre-norm block: per-modality attn_norm + MoTAttention + per-modality mlp_norm + per-modality FFN. Dense FFN branches' down_proj zero-init for warm-start identity. MoE FFN branches (when (i+1) % moe_frequency == 0) skip zero-init

VisionEncoder.purpose: Base class for vision encoders. Subclasses provide `forward(pixel_values) -> features` of shape (B, num_tokens, feature_dim)

RandomVisionEncoder(VisionEncoder).purpose: Test-stub vision encoder: deterministic random features by image_id hash. No download; used for VLM smokes

_HFVisionEncoder(VisionEncoder).purpose: Wraps a HuggingFace vision model (SigLIP2 or CLIP). Optionally strips the [CLS] token. Stays in HF's loaded dtype; the adapter casts at the boundary. feature_dim is the builder's, else the tower config's hidden_size; a config without one raises asking for vision_encoder.feature_dim

Adapter.purpose: 2-layer MLP from vision-feature dim to LLM embedding dim. reset_parameters() supports meta-device materialization

ModalityStrategy (Protocol).purpose: Composes raw VLM inputs into a ModalityContext. Stateless (holds no parameters); read submodules off the VLMWrapper. NOT registered as a submodule, so FSDP2 does not wrap them and DCP does not serialize them
methods: prepare(wrapper, pixel_values, input_ids, frame_mask=None, *, image_rows=None, image_starts=None, image_tokens=None, text_rows=None, text_positions=None) -> ModalityContext

JointDecoderStrategy.purpose: Joint-Decoder: image embeds prepended to text. Fills prefix_embeds + output_slice; a packed batch (image_rows/image_starts/image_tokens, text_rows/text_positions) takes the inline route instead: inline_embeds over the placeholder slots, output_rows/output_positions so the head runs on the text positions

CrossAttentionStrategy.purpose: Cross-Attention: image embeds flow as K/V into separate CA blocks. Fills image_features + image_mask

MoTStrategy.purpose: Mixture-of-Transformers: prefix_embeds + output_slice + per-position modality_ids (0=image, 1=text). Same residual-stream layout as JD, plus the routing tag the MoTBlock stack consumes

VLMWrapper(nn.Module).purpose: VLM wrapper composing vision_encoder + adapter + transformer + strategy. Strategy is a plain Python object, not an nn.Module submodule
methods: forward(pixel_values, input_ids, labels, frame_mask, *, doc_ids, position_ids, attention_group_ids, image_rows, image_starts, image_tokens, text_rows, text_positions) -> (logits, labels)
train(mode=True) (keeps a vision encoder whose parameters are all frozen in eval mode)

functions: packed_tokens_per_image(model) -> int  # slots one image takes in a packed row, read off the built VLMWrapper

KVCache.purpose: Pre-allocated KV cache for autoregressive generation

Attention.purpose: Grouped-Query Attention with RoPE, SDPA or FlexAttention over the one attn_mask built per forward, optional QK-norm, lower-right causal bias for tokens appended to a KV cache, attention weight capture
methods: forward(x, rope_cos, rope_sin, *, kv_cache, attn_mask) (refuses a dense attn_mask under sdpa_backend=flash on CUDA)

functions: flex_attention_fn(compiled) -> Callable  # torch.compile'd on CUDA, eager on CPU
use_dynamic_flex_shapes(enabled) -> None  # select the flex pair compiled for a varying batch size (packed VLM runs) or the pinned-shape pair
kempnerforge/model/masking.py.purpose: FlexAttention BlockMask builders for packed sequences (model.attention_backend='flex'); replaces the dense (B, 1, S, S) SDPA mask

StandardMLP.purpose: Standard two-layer MLP with configurable activation

kempnerforge/model/init.py.purpose: Standard initialization: Linear+Embedding ~ N(0, init_std); residual o_proj/down_proj scaled by 1/sqrt(2*n_layers); cross-attention block o_proj/down_proj zero-init; MoT per-modality o_proj.{m}.weight + mlp.{m}.down_proj.weight zero-init via a second isinstance pass (MoTAttention / MoTBlock)

MoEMLP.purpose: Mixture-of-Experts feed-forward layer with router dispatch
methods: _keep_in_graph(output, params) -> Tensor (adds a zero-valued term of params so each gets a gradient under FSDP2)

functions: build_moe(dim, hidden_dim, num_experts, top_k, activation, router_type, shared_experts, capacity_factor, gradient_scale, sequence_aux_loss_weight, bias_schedule, packed_experts) -> MoEMLP
grouped_expert_forward_packed(x_sorted, tokens_per_expert, up_w, down_w, gate_w, activation) -> Tensor

SoftmaxTopKRouter.purpose: Mixtral-style softmax top-k router with aux load-balancing loss

Recomputing.purpose: Context of an activation-checkpoint recompute: routers compute as in the forward but set no attribute and count no token; enters the selective-checkpoint context inside; re-enterable

SigmoidTopKRouter.purpose: DeepSeek-V3 style sigmoid router: expert_bias frozen to the optimizer (always_frozen), balanced once per optimizer step from pending_counts; adaptive scheduling, sequence aux loss
properties: fp32_ema_bits, fp32_bias_bits (FP32 masters held as int32 bits; derived_buffers)
methods: balance(counts) (moves the EMA and the bias from a step's summed counts on the FP32 masters; updates the FSDP2 shard in place)
_masters() (FP32 views of the master bit buffers)
_load_from_state_dict(...) (derives absent masters from expert_ema and expert_bias)
derive_buffers(names) (starts the named masters from the loaded expert_ema and expert_bias; gathers an FSDP2 shard)

functions: generate(model, prompt_tokens, max_new_tokens, *, temperature, top_k, top_p, eos_token_id) -> Tensor

ActivationStore.purpose: Forward hook manager for capturing intermediate activations to CPU

functions: extract_representations(model, dataset, layers, device, batch_size, max_samples) -> dict[str, Tensor]

Lion.purpose: Sign-based momentum optimizer (Chen et al. 2023), half optimizer memory of AdamW

ScheduleFreeAdamW.purpose: Schedule-Free AdamW (Defazio & Mishchenko 2024), eliminates LR schedule via iterate averaging; each parameter's step count lives in its optimizer state
methods: load_state_dict(state_dict) (maps a legacy optimizer-wide _k onto each parameter's step)

functions: evaluation_point(optimizer, model=None) -> context manager (eval_params() inside, train_params() after; reshards the model's FSDP2 units around the swap)

_module_owners(model, modules, module_patterns) -> (owners, enclosing) (over every parameter name; a parameter several listed modules match goes to the one whose matches the others strictly contain; identical or partly overlapping matches are refused)
run_eval(model, eval_dataloader, loss_fn, device, eval_steps, *, pp_schedule, pp_rank, pp_size, pp_group, pp_n_microbatches, dp_groups) -> dict

kempnerforge/training/freeze.py.purpose: Freeze utilities: resolve module aliases / fnmatch patterns to parameter names, flip requires_grad, build canonical metadata for checkpoint validation, compute effective freeze at a given step from base specs + a freeze_schedule with start_step boundaries
functions: trainable_during_run(model, config) -> set[str] (names of the parameters that train at some step: after the build freeze, each FreezeStage, or a resume; never a parameter its module names in always_frozen)
trainable_for_the_run(model, config) -> Iterator[list[str]] (context manager: those parameters require grad while the optimizer is built or a checkpoint loaded)

StepContext.purpose: Per-step context dataclass passed to hooks (step, loss, grad_norm, lr, tokens_seen, model, optimizer)

TrainingHook.purpose: Base class for training loop hooks — override only the methods you need

HookRunner.purpose: Dispatches hook calls to registered hooks, zero cost when empty

RuntimeContext.purpose: Ranks, device, DeviceMesh, and the DP view of it

PipelineBundle.purpose: PP rank/size/schedule (pp > 1 only); the process group is derived on demand

DataPipeline.purpose: Training dataset/loader plus mixture dataset, sampler, weights

PhaseState.purpose: Data-annealing phases plus the active index and lr_scale

BatchStream.purpose: Dataloader + live iterator with epoch restart; reset() hands the restart to the loader's restart() when it has one; close() stops the loader's workers through its close(), or shutdown_workers for a plain DataLoader

StepResult.purpose: Loss, grad norm, positions run, text-token count, per-source token and loss tensors, and a VLM step's documents, image and text tokens and encoder images from one step

TrainingSession.purpose: Collaborators the step loop needs after the build phase, and a VLM run's documents_seen

functions: _apply_stage_specs(model, specs, pattern_map) -> dict (one FreezeStage: refreshes the FSDP2 dtypes of what it unfreezes and resets a compiled model when it unfreezes parameters)
_step_counts(session, result) -> (tokens, documents, encoder_images) over the DP ranks

kempnerforge/training/entry.py.purpose: Training job orchestration — build phases, run the loop, tear down
functions: build_model(config, runtime, loss_fn) -> tuple[Module, PipelineBundle | None]
build_checkpoint_manager(config, runtime, model, optimizer, pipeline) -> CheckpointManager
restore_checkpoint(config, model, scheduler, ckpt_mgr) -> tuple[int, int]
_trainable_for_the_run(model, config) (trainable_for_the_run for a VLM with a freeze schedule, else a context that changes nothing)

HuggingFaceDataset.purpose: HuggingFace dataset with tokenization and sequence packing

StreamingHuggingFaceDataset.purpose: Streaming HuggingFace IterableDataset for large corpora, split across data-parallel ranks with split_dataset_by_node

MixtureDataset.purpose: Concatenates multiple datasets with global indexing and per-sample dataset_idx

DataPositionError.purpose: ValueError for a saved data position this loader cannot resume from; CheckpointManager shares every rank's verdict first, so every rank raises it together

StatefulDataLoader.purpose: DataLoader wrapper with checkpoint/resume state tracking; with a DistributedSampler the position is global, so it resumes on another data-parallel size or batch size
methods: close() (shuts the workers down through the sentinel path and keeps the position; rank-local, no collective; a process also calls it at exit while the workers are alive)
restart() (drops the live iterator for BatchStream.reset; without persistent workers the saved base seed state goes too, since the next iterator draws a new one)
state_dict() (with base_seed_rng_state, the CPU RNG state its iterator drew the workers' base seed from)

load_state_dict(state) (closes first; the next iterator draws its base seed from the saved state, except where a loader without persistent workers starts the next epoch; a state without it warns where that matters)
check_state(state) (raises the DataPositionError load_state_dict would, changing nothing)

StreamingDataLoader.purpose: DataLoader over a StreamingHuggingFaceDataset that resumes by replaying the saved batch count, logging progress; refuses a stream whose source files, shard count or settings changed, and starts fresh workers when a pass restarts midway; each rank saves its own count with its data-parallel rank; a replay that runs off the end of the rank's part of the pass, and a later pass on another rank's count or one with no recorded rank, warn in every rank's log
methods: close() (as StatefulDataLoader.close; the next pass replays to the position)
restart() (as StatefulDataLoader.restart; a pass in progress stops its workers, and the saved base seed state goes)
check_state(state) (raises the DataPositionError load_state_dict would, changing nothing; compares the stream as this rank sees it)
load_state_dict(state) (closes first; the next iterator draws its base seed from the saved state)

_BaseSeed.purpose: The CPU RNG state a loader's iterator drew its workers' base seed from; after load(), the next new iterator draws its base seed from the loaded state through its own generator, leaving the CPU RNG untouched, so a resume continues the CPU RNG and the workers' seeds
methods: iterate(loader) (iter(loader), recording the state a new iterator draws from)
end_pass(loader) (drops the state when the next pass starts a new iterator: no persistent workers)
drop() (the next iterator draws a new base seed)

functions: shutdown_workers(loader) (stops a DataLoader's persistent workers through the sentinel path: the pin-memory thread, torch's worker shutdown, then a kill for a worker still alive; every wait bounded; rank-local, no collective)
_close_at_exit(loader) (registers the atexit hook again at each start of workers)
_close_open_loaders() (closes the loaders whose workers this process started)
_warn_new_base_seed() (a resume from a state saved without base_seed_rng_state)

DistributedSampler.purpose: Deterministic distributed sampler with skip-ahead for resumption

MixtureSampler.purpose: Weighted sampler over MixtureDataset with temperature scaling and oversampling

HuggingFaceVLMDataset.purpose: Map-style VLM dataset over a HuggingFace Dataset (Hub id or local save_to_disk path). Tokenizes captions, normalizes images, returns (pixel_values, input_ids, labels) per sample

VLMCollator.purpose: Fixed-length pad collator for VLM batches. Pads input_ids and labels to max_text_len so NCCL collectives stay rank-consistent under FSDP2

PackedVLMCollator.purpose: Packs a micro-batch's documents into rows of seq_len via pack_vlm_samples; the row count varies with the documents, so train.batch_size is documents per micro-batch

functions: pack_vlm_samples(samples, *, seq_len, tokens_per_image, pad_id) -> dict: first-fit documents into rows; emits doc_ids, position_ids, image_rows/image_starts/image_tokens and text_rows/text_positions
build_parallel_model(model_config, device, device_mesh, *, ac_mode, mp_policy, param_dtype, compile_model, fp8) -> nn.Module (dispatches to _build_vlm when model_config.vlm is set)
_build_vlm(model_config, device, device_mesh, *, ac_mode, mp_policy, param_dtype, compile_model, fp8) -> VLMWrapper
_routing_contexts() -> (forward, recompute) contexts (the recompute takes the forward's aten.topk outputs and runs as a Recomputing)
_RoutingCheckpointWrapper (CheckpointWrapper of a block holding an MoEMLP under full AC; runs eagerly under torch.compile)
_keep_tied_head(model, filter_fn) -> filter (keeps an output head tied to the token embedding out of Float8 conversion)
apply_fsdp2(model, device_mesh, mp_policy, reshard_after_forward) (text-only path; shares _fsdp_wrap_transformer_blocks with VLM)
_apply_fsdp_vlm(wrapper, device_mesh, mp_policy, reshard_after_forward) (VLM-aware FSDP: inner Transformer per-block + adapter + encoder wrap unless no step of the run trains it)
_fsdp_wrap_transformer_blocks(transformer, dp_mesh, policy, reshard_after_forward) (EP-MoE-aware per-block FSDP wrap; iterates transformer.layers and transformer.cross_attention_layers)
refresh_fsdp_dtypes(model, params) (recomputes the reduction dtypes of the FSDP2 units that manage params; collective)

_AllToAll.purpose: Differentiable all-to-all autograd function for expert dispatch

_ScaleGrad.purpose: Identity forward that scales the gradient, averaging routed-expert gradients over the EP group

functions: ep_dispatch_and_compute(x, weights, indices, moe, ep_group, local_expert_start, num_local_experts, ep_world_size, gradient_scale) -> Tensor

PipelineStageModule.purpose: Model chunk for a single pipeline stage

functions: build_pipeline_stage(stage_module, device_mesh, device, batch_size, seq_len, param_dtype) -> PipelineStage

RankStateMismatchError.purpose: ValueError for per-rank state saved under another world size or data-parallel layout; every rank raises it together, mismatch holds what changed without the way out, and checkpoint.ignore_rank_state_mismatch resumes past it keeping the data position

functions: build_train_state(step, tokens_seen, scheduler, dataloader, extra, per_rank) -> dict (records scheduler_group_modules when a param group names a module, and the per-rank envelope under per_rank)
restore_train_state(state, scheduler, dataloader, lr_multipliers) -> (step, tokens_seen, extra)
capture_rank_state(dataloader) -> dict (this rank's RNG capture and loader state)
dp_coordinates(value) -> (dp_rank, dp_size) | None (a valid pair of ints with 0 <= dp_rank < dp_size, else None)
build_per_rank_envelope(entries, world_size, data_parallel) -> dict (versioned envelope of every rank's payload and the data-parallel layout)

select_rank_state(envelope, rank, world_size, data_parallel) -> dict (this rank's payload; ValueError for an unsound envelope, RankStateMismatchError for another world size or layout, the same verdict on every rank)

saved_data_position(envelope, data_parallel) -> dict | None (the saved loader state a rank resumes from on another topology, checked on the topology that saved it: rank 0's, or for a stream on the saved data-parallel size the one its own data-parallel rank saved)

_scheduler_state_for(scheduler, saved, saved_modules, lr_multipliers) -> dict (lays a LambdaLR state out by module for other param groups; a module with no saved group runs at the saved peak times its multiplier)

CheckpointManager.purpose: DCP-based distributed checkpoint save/load/cleanup manager. Cross-arch VLM freeze-metadata validation, rank-0-authoritative train_state existence broadcast (NFS/Lustre stat() race), ownership-gated train_state.pt load. Per-rank loader/RNG envelope: an exact resume restores each rank's own entry and refuses a changed world size or data-parallel layout on every rank; checkpoint.ignore_rank_state_mismatch resumes past the refusal, keeping the saved data position (rank 0's, or for a stream on the saved data-parallel size each data-parallel rank's own) where every rank's loader can place it, else restarting the data on every rank, and restarting the RNG streams
methods: has_pending_save (property: an async save to drain or a latest commit to make)
load(path, scheduler, dataloader, exclude_keys, vlm_freeze_expected, fresh_if_unheld, warm_start, exact_resume, plugins_expected)

_per_rank_view(train_state) -> (view, carried) (on an exact resume, this rank's own envelope entry over the single-copy keys; a mismatch refuses unless ignore_rank_state_mismatch, and a checkpoint with no envelope restores rank 0's copy unless that flag is set)

_resume_past_mismatch(view, envelope, error) -> (view, carried) (with ignore_rank_state_mismatch: a changed topology keeps the saved data position if the envelope is sound where it was saved, rank 0's or for a stream on the saved data-parallel size its own data-parallel rank's, else drops it; never restores RNG)

_resume_without_rank_state(train_state) -> (view, carried) (with ignore_rank_state_mismatch, a checkpoint with no per-rank state resumes as if the topology changed: rank 0's data position kept, its RNG dropped)

_read_saved_keys(dcp_dir) -> (keys, restored_on_any_rank) (this rank's DCP keys; with a scope or multipliers an all-reduce on the gloo group tells every rank whether any rank's index holds optimizer state)

_broadcast_metadata(ckpt_dir) -> (meta, error) (rank 0 reads metadata.json once per load and broadcasts the object or why it could not; the scope, multipliers and group-layout checks all decide from it)
_check_plugins(metadata, ckpt_dir, expected) (every rank refuses another plugins list before any state is read, unless checkpoint.ignore_plugins_mismatch)
_broadcast_train_state(path) -> dict (rank 0 reads train_state.pt and broadcasts the state or why it could not; rank 0 re-raises its error, every other rank raises a RuntimeError naming it)
_check_weight_decay_scope(metadata, ckpt_dir) (every rank refuses a mismatch or an unreadable record)

_check_lr_multipliers(metadata, ckpt_dir) -> saved group modules | None (every rank refuses other multipliers or patterns; a run without multipliers loads past an unreadable record with a warning; runs once per load, before loading optimizer state on any rank or before restoring a scheduler from train_state.pt)
_present_experts(dcp_state, load_from, saved_keys) (EP experts placed among all of them before DCP; a load refuses a checkpoint of fewer experts than the model; the ranks agree before DCP)

apply_dataloader_state(dataloader) (every rank checks the position and the ranks share their verdicts before any rank applies it; a position some rank cannot place raises DataPositionError on every rank on a resume and starts the data fresh on every rank, with a warning, on a warm start or a carried position; a carried position goes only to a StatefulDataLoader or StreamingDataLoader)
_position_refusals(dataloader, state) -> (refusals, world) (each rank's check_state verdict, gathered on every rank on the gloo group; a check that fails another way raises on every rank)
claim_dir() (rank 0 claims <dir>/.owner through claim_checkpoint_dir; every rank agrees on the outcome)
release_dir() (marks the <dir>/.owner record this rank's claim_dir wrote released, at a clean exit)
restored_extra (property: the extra keys the last load restored)

_agreed_load_dir(path, fall_back) -> Path | None (every load: rank 0 resolves the checkpoint, on an exact resume that reads shards takes the newest step_N beside it that every stage saved when that one is not, and broadcasts its choice or its error)

functions: _read_metadata(ckpt_dir) -> dict (the JSON object metadata.json holds; empty when there is none)
_recorded_lr_layout(meta, metadata_path) -> (patterns, group_modules) (lr_module_patterns, and lr_group_modules: the module of each optimizer param group, recorded without PP)

_check_saved_param_groups(optim_state, saved_keys, where, groups_vary, saved_modules) (refuses another group count, a missing setting, a module key where this run has none, or another module at a position per the recorded lr_group_modules)
derived_buffer_owners(model) -> dict (state-dict key of each buffer a module lists in derived_buffers -> (module, buffer name))
drop_derived_model_keys(model_state, model, saved_keys) -> dict (takes out of a load template the derived buffers its checkpoint lacks; put back before set_model_state_dict)
derive_buffers(model, keys) (the owner of each derived buffer at keys recomputes it from its loaded state)

_fit_saved_optimizer(optim_state, owners, fixed, left_out, saved_keys, where, groups_vary, saved_modules, layout) -> taken groups (checks the saved state kinds, each EP expert under its global name, takes the groups the save kept none of, drops legacy group keys, then checks the remaining groups; when none can be taken, the group check speaks before the generic mismatch error)

_params_the_save_left_out(fqns, saved_keys, layout) -> set[str] (named parameters with neither saved optimizer state nor a never-stepped record, compared by global expert names under expert parallelism)

_restore_left_out(optim_state, template_groups, left_out, where) (empty state for them, in the saved group of their group's other parameters, every EP rank's experts included, or an empty saved group in its place; refuses a name the saved groups list; load() agrees on its outcome across ranks)

ExpertLayout.purpose: Translates a DCP state dict between one EP rank's experts and all of them: unpacked experts under their global index, packed weights as views over the FSDP mesh and ep holding every expert's rows, with optimizer state and param-group lists to match
